description: Fetch a stored verdict by receipt id (GET /api/v1/receipts/{id}) to re-check an earlier result. No key. The receipt is content-hashed, reproducible from the open-source core it names, and signed with Ed25519 by a key published at https://canlicapital.com/.well-known/canli-receipt-keys.json.

id.description: Receipt id from a validation result.

name: get_receipt
title: Get a receipt
